name: Charter Cordhandle
description: Lower the brow like a hawk and keep both cords loosely crossed over the chest.

name: Hoarfrost Gripdowel
description: Throw two loops at once, one over the head and one over the weapon hand.

name: Silt Constrict
description: Circle the quarry in a shrinking spiral, each pass a half step closer.

name: Wirescourge
description: Hook the cord ends like talons into the soft flesh beneath the jaw.

name: Slipknot Wrath
description: Alternate left and right pulls in a steady twin cadence that never lets the throat relax.

name: Equipoise Noosering
description: Let one cord go slack and the other taut so a grab finds only the slack one.

name: Gyve Barbedwire
description: Drop from a height with the paired loop already open, closing it as the feet land.

name: Flintlike Wirebraid
description: Spin both cords in opposing rings that parry blades from either side of the body.

name: Nova Cinch
description: Cross a long gap in a single stoop, paired cords flying behind, and land on the target's back.

name: Charter Toggle
description: Open with the courteous bow, both hands lowered and the cord looped about the wrists.

name: Gyvecinch
description: Cast the loop in a long river curve that closes only at the end of its run.

name: Lightning Handlebar
description: Walk the bank side of the target, always on the side the water would flow past.

name: Cordbraid Tenacity
description: Press the cord on the inner wrist to pin the weapon hand against the target's belt.

name: Shade Tighten
description: Tighten the cord by slow degrees, as river water fills a channel.

name: Hoarfrost Slipnoose
description: Pool qi in the anchoring hand so it holds the loop without strain through a long contest.

name: Noosevalor
description: Turn the cord with the current of an incoming blow and let it run past the shoulder.

name: Deedtoggle
description: Arrange a weir of cords across a lane so a runner is slowed, caught and drawn tight.

name: Doctrine Throttle
description: Bow, cast, circle and close in the fixed order of the court, each step covering the last.

name: Ferocious Noosering
description: Pull as a deep current draws a swimmer down, sapping the target's qi along with the breath.

name: Gust Cordhandle
description: Tap the throat line lightly with the cord, then withdraw as if the strike had failed.

name: Unbudging Barbedwire
description: Hold the cord overhead against a bright sky so its thin line vanishes from sight.

name: Wirecore Vortex
description: Glide along a shadow's edge and into the target's rear arc.

name: Webbing Garrote
description: Lock the cord along the throat line so the jaw cannot tuck and the head cannot turn.

name: Probing Cordbraid
description: Read the neck pulse through the cord and tune the pressure to its beat.

name: Noosemettle
description: Show a half draw in front, then cross the cord to the back in the target's blind angle.

name: Titanic Garrote
description: Run a hair-thin line of qi along the cord to open a path through a guard of mail.

name: Deed Slipnoose
description: Hold the cord at the throat line while qi traps the target's breath and cultivation in the chest.

name: Psyche Gripdowel
description: Strike the throat line in a precise draw that bypasses the flesh and breaks the flow of qi within.

name: Irontoggle
description: Breathe in two tracks, one for the body and one for qi, with the cord resting ready at the hip.

name: Gust Constrict
description: Land heel and toe at the same instant so each step makes no sound.

name: Toggle Durance
description: Cast the loop with a flick too soft to stir the cloth of the target's collar.

name: Fastening Wirecore
description: Drag the target backward without sound, one slow step to each pull of the cord.

name: Sanguine Slipknot
description: Press the free palm over the mouth just as the cord closes at the neck.

name: Ponderous Handlebar
description: Dampen the target's qi with a steady second track of pressure so no shout carries power.

name: Strangling Throttle
description: Lay a damping skin of qi along both cords to veil the noise of the struggle.

name: Gripdowel Mettle
description: Slip a grappling hand on the body track while the qi track keeps the cord taut.

name: Wrathful Wirebraid
description: Draw both tracks together in a hushed pull that ends a fight before anyone nearby has noticed.

name: Remorseless Noosering
description: Lay two joined hidden cords across a doorway so the second tightens as the first is tripped.

name: Hogtying Barbedwire Nerve
description: Close both tracks on the neck so that voice, qi and breath all stop together.

name: Granite Cordhandle
description: Hold the cord low at the hip and draw the cloak over it so only darkness shows.

name: Silttoggle
description: Step from shadow to shadow and never cross a patch of lamplight.

name: Harnessing Throttle
description: Drop the loop from beneath a cloak's edge and pull the cloth open with the cord.

name: Suffocating Wirebraid
description: Draw the target around a corner or post so the cord turns with them and the pull multiplies.

name: Cinchwrath
description: Dull the cord's sheen with qi so it cannot be seen and tighten it by touch alone.

name: Torrent Toggle
description: Slip the cord into a turning shoulder and send a cut past in the dark.

name: Cordbraid Obduracy
description: Stretch a hollow ring of hidden cords around a courtyard so any who cross it are caught together.

name: Grievous Wirecore
description: Draw the paired cords at once, one from each flank, through gaps in the target's guard.

name: Toggleblink
description: Vanish from before the target and appear behind him with the cord already closed.

name: Facet Handlebar
description: Stand with one cord streaming from each hand, forearms parallel, both guarding the center line.

name: Fastening Tighten
description: Cast a low loop and a high loop so the pair draw together at the neck.

name: Siltnoose
description: Step so the target's arms and shoulders line up behind one cord, leaving the other free.

name: Granite Slipnoose
description: Flick the loose end to knock the target's chin up as the loops meet.

name: Hour Slipknot
description: Send qi down the left cord alone and pull until the target's weaker arm drops.

name: Equipoise Wirebraid
description: Let the right cord catch a thrust and send it along the left cord's line away from the body.

name: Hoarfrost Garrote
description: Knot the two cords at the nape in one twist so the loops cannot be parted.

name: Strangling Tighten
description: Let both streams of qi flow into the knot until the loops hold by their own power.

name: Septic Toggle
description: Lay paired cords in an eddy pattern across a courtyard so a running foot is swept back into them.

name: Hellish Handlebar
description: Pour both streams down the cords as a torrent that crushes the throat and drains the target's qi.

name: Impervious Slipknot
description: Stand in the open with no wall at the back and the cord drawn taut as the only guard.

name: Gripdowel Durance
description: Swing the loop wide with the wind and let it fall around a neck at the end of its swing.

name: Torrent Cinch
description: Run low across open ground with the cord trailing to reach a target who expects no pursuit.

name: Strandwrath
description: Tap the toggle against the throat in the first oath, a warning blow that numbs.

name: Maiming Cordhandle
description: Keep the loop shut in a steady stream of qi, like a gale leaning on one point.

name: Toggleglare
description: Glide away on the pull of the cord to put the held target between you and any rescuer.

name: Guststrand
description: Let a blow drive the slack into a loop that catches and turns the striking arm.

name: Cinch Hardihood
description: Tie the sworn knot in one hand, a knot no wind or struggle can shake loose.

name: Ponderous Noosering
description: Drive the cord with surges of qi in the rhythm of a rising gale until the target's strength gives way.

name: Hour Throttle
description: Pass through the target's guard like wind through open grass and appear at his back with the cord set.

name: Aegiswire
description: Swear the oath aloud and stand with the loop held open before the chest as a guard.

name: Silt Slipnoose
description: Pace in at the speed of a rising wind, steady enough that the target hears nothing change.

name: Gyve Wirecore
description: Let the sworn loop leave the hand in one throw and close it with the returning pull.

name: Numbing Constrict
description: Cast the loop along a sworn bearing so it finds the neck however the target turns.

name: Hourtoggle
description: Hold the tension like a gale leaning on one cliff, neither easing nor surging.

name: Strandspine
description: Cut the cord through a rising draft to carry a stab off its line.

name: Doctrine Garrote
description: Throw, close, pivot and re-throw the oath loop in one chain against two opponents.

name: Togglevalor
description: Pre-set a loop on the plateau trail so a passer's step draws it taut at the ankle.

name: Immobilizing Cinch
description: Press the oath into the cord so the loop breaks the flow of the target's qi for as long as it is held.

name: Barbedwire Valor
description: Fix the eyes on the target's neck and keep the cord level at the waist as a screen.

name: Wireglimmer
description: Lunge along the heading without a curve, trusting the cord to land where the eyes rest.

name: Harnessing Constrict
description: Turn the hips fully into the throw so the loop lands with force enough to seat itself.

name: Togglewrath
description: Snap the cord against the wrist that bears the weapon to open the grip.

name: Wirebraid Reckoning
description: Keep the bearing steady while the pull deepens, ignoring every twist the target makes.

name: Murk Cordbraid
description: Slip off the line of a charge and swing the cord back onto the same bearing.

name: Waning Slipknot
description: Run a thread of qi to the target's neck and feel its heading even in darkness.

name: Facetnoose
description: Pierce the guard with a single hard draw on the bearing so it cannot be turned.

name: Strandruin
description: Pass the bearing between both hands in turn so the pull never pauses to rest.

name: Punishing Constrict Havoc
description: Complete the last draw so its force bypasses armor and flesh and strikes the inner structures of the throat.

name: Facetwire
description: Hold the long cord in wide coils over the shoulder so any blow meets cord before body.

name: Veritytoggle
description: Raise a wetted finger to read the wind and judge how far it will carry the loop.

name: Thorn Slipnoose
description: Fling the loop down a gust so it carries far past the cast's natural reach.

name: Torrent Cordbraid
description: Run along the open ridge on the same line as the cord to close a gap.

name: Mastering Tighten
description: Ride a thread of qi on the wind to steer the loop's final fall.

name: Immobilizing Tighten
description: Whirl the cord until its whistle hides the direction from which the loop will fall.

name: Grievous Throttle
description: Pull with the whole length of the cord as a rein and let the wind add to the draw.

name: Cordhandle Mettle
description: Stretch the long cord between two ridge stones at neck height across a rider's path.

name: Thornnoose
description: Hurl the cord into a gale and let it follow the target through any turn before closing on his neck.

name: Ironwire
description: Stand with palms open and the cord draped across the wrists, hiding its use until needed.

name: Maiming Toggle
description: Cast the loop underhand so it rises past the chin and settles at the nape.

name: Nooseglare
description: Close the gap in a burst of three paces, each faster, like a gust gathering.

name: Obdurate Barbedwire
description: Break a punch's line with an elbow and slide the cord around the same arm.

name: Mighttoggle
description: Draw back sharply, as a rider reins in, to yank the head back and clip the chin.

name: Charter Wirecore
description: Spiral the pull outward in widening gusts that wear on the target's footing.

name: Overbearing Gripdowel
description: Release one handle in a sudden shear that jolts a channeled technique off its line.

name: Enthralling Noosering
description: Let the loop drift on the air a heartbeat before closing so it never seems to move.

name: Cinchspine
description: Anchor the cord to a post, rock or stirrup and let the gusting struggle tighten it.

name: Escalating Cinch
description: Draw, spin, release and re-cast in the loose rhythm of the open gale.

name: Titanic Wirebraid Wrath
description: Raise the pull as a wind rises, each surge carrying more of the field until the target cannot stand.

name: Granite Cordbraid
description: Crouch with the cord pulled back across the thighs, giving the target nothing to read.

name: Torrential Cinch
description: Time each step to a gust so that wind noise covers the sound of the foot.

name: Slipnoose Valor
description: Throw the loop in one burst the instant a gust strikes the target's face.

name: Unbowed Gripdowel
description: Slip a blow with the cord on a draft of qi that turns the weapon outward.

name: Gnashing Slipknot
description: Draw hard on the first gust so the cord bites before the throat can tense.

name: Garrote Reckoning
description: Carry the pull through the gust's whole length and renew it with the next.

name: Cinchmettle
description: Cinch the loop with a sharp twist of both wrists that locks it against all pulling.

name: Harnessing Wirecore
description: Seat the cord at the nape and close the flow of cultivation through the neck.

name: Dismantling Barbedwire
description: End the contest in one gust-timed draw that strikes the inner throat beyond any outward guard.
